packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major Go module updates; majors still need manual review. CI (the branch checks) gates every merge.
Always track the latest GitHub Actions (including major bumps) and auto-merge. config:best-practices pins each action to a commit SHA; CI gates the merge.

Rebuild and commit the vendored SvelteKit SPA whenever a ui/ dependency changes, so the 'ui vendored-asset drift' check stays green (the UI analog of gomodTidy). Renovate runs postUpgradeTasks shell-free (it shlex-splits the string and spawns argv[0] directly), so the recipe is wrapped in a single `bash -c '…'`: the whole `&&` chain then runs in one bash process — `cd` works as a builtin, and a failed `pnpm build` short-circuits before `rm -rf`, preserving the build→vendor interlock (a bare array of commands would NOT short-circuit and could commit the deletion). `installTools.pnpm` installs pnpm at the repo's packageManager major (the runner's bundled pnpm is older). CROSS-REPO: the self-hosted bot pins this exact command string by anchored exact-match allowlist, so any edit here needs a paired selfhosted-cluster allowedCommands update landed cluster-first.

commands: bash -c 'cd ui && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && rm -rf ../internal/webauth/static && mkdir -p ../internal/webauth/static && cp -R build/. ../internal/webauth/static/'

packageRules.description: Block cookie major bumps: cookie v2 is an ESM-only API rewrite (parse→parseCookie, serialize→stringifyCookie) that @sveltejs/kit 2.68.0 does not support — a v2 bump breaks the SPA build at the pnpm build step (caught by the 'ui vendored-asset drift' check). The ui/pnpm-workspace.yaml override forces cookie up only to clear GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x (cookie <0.7.0); ^1.0.0 already clears it, so v2 adds no security value. Minor/patch within 1.x remain allowed.
